cim: South Bend workshop examines AI’s role in housing discrimination
cim_eredeti: South Bend workshop examines AI’s role in housing discrimination
szoveg_eredeti: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being used to help make housing decisions, raising concerns about how algorithms could contribute to discrimination. The South Bend Human Rights Commission hosted a free workshop Wednesday focused on the intersection of artificial intelligence, housing and civil rights.
